notes.title: Damned Daniel NEW Game Updates! FREE Content Update!
notes.notes:
Hello you luvly peoples!

[b]Thank you so much for all your support on my game dev journey and for playing Damned Daniel![/b]

I've been going through all the reviews you beautiful people have left on the game and it is really amazing to have your feedback, I read each and every one and I appreciate them ALL!

Now... I have decided there needs to be some changes to Damned Daniel before the sequel is released. 
(Yes, I'm working on it!)

[u][b]Changes in Damned Daniel[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added in 30% more NEW NPC's with unique interaction!
[*] Added in new *Choice Matters* decisions that affect your gameplay!
[*] New items with cool effects!
[*] Smacked the Tweedle Bosses around a bit with the Nerf Stick. (They kinda liked it)
[*] Added in NEW interactable items hidden in the world for exploration!
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the changes and are looking forward to Damned Daniel's second chapter as much as I look forward to releasing it!

I want to thank you once again for your AMAZING support, I hope to provide more lols in future projects <3
